locations.label: Jet Gun workbench · Motor Lodge
locations.description: A room that will burst open with zombies when approached. Contains a workbench and hints on how to build the Wonder Weapon.

locations.label: Radio House
locations.description: Doors can be shot open with a mangler canon, either by the player crafting one and shooting it, or getting shot by a mangler by accident.

locations.label: Groundskeepers Shed
locations.description: Contains the Handbrake for the Jet Gun quest. Can only be opened by using the shed key. You can find the groundskeeper zombie in the cemetery, kill him before he teleports away, dropping his key.

locations.label: Wires
locations.description: Search the debris piles inside Radio House for the wires after opening its shutter with a Mangler cannon blast. This pin marks the search room, not a guaranteed pile.
locations.conditions: Possible location; the active spawn or chosen site depends on the current run.

locations.label: Water valve · Lily’s Flowerpot

locations.label: S.D.G Generator
locations.description:
(Simultaneous Dimensional Gateway)
A device that uses charged aetherium canisters to close the dark aether. Players must charge 2 canisters and return them here to begin the boss battle.

locations.label: Free Deadshot
locations.description: Shoot all of the cans on the fence outside the cemetary to be rewarded with a free deadshot perk. You're timed and only one person can get it per game.

locations.label: Max Ammo
locations.description: Look down at the yellow bridge between the barrier and the start of the yellow steel beams. Shoot the small golden object to spawn a free power up.

locations.label: Bonus Points
locations.description: Look up at the window, shoot the small golden object to spawn a free power up.

locations.label: Nuke
locations.description: Look down through the bank roof, shoot the small golden object to spawn a free power up.

locations.label: Insta Kill
locations.description: Up on the top of the church roof. Shoot the small golden object to spawn a free power up.

locations.label: Double Points
locations.description: Up on the water tower, shoot or grenade it to spawn a free power up.

locations.label: Max Armour
locations.description: Through the barricade in the bottom right corner of the room on a tray.

locations.label: Full Power
locations.description: Behind the barrier between the cars. Might need to go up on top of the verge by the scope in order to see it.

locations.label: Fire Sale
locations.description:
Only appears after shooting all 7 other power ups.
Inside the bin.

locations.label: Falling Zombies!
locations.description: Cook a grenade and throw it at the zombie head on the roof to trigger a zombie rain that drop loot.

locations.label: Mr Peeks - Bowling!
locations.description:
Find all collectibles on the map to be teleported to the bowling alley for a game and a reward!
After shooting all the shoes you will be teleported here to bowl! Score 300 for a darkops challenge, you'll always get a reward.

locations.label: Mr Peeks - Bowling Shoe

After gaining entry player can bring a loot key (dropped by specials & elites) to open any of the 9 lootable deposit boxes.

targets.title: Church · Pack-a-Punch & S.D.G.
targets.description: Open church → Pack-a-Punch → interact with the S.D.G. on the right wall.

targets.title: Water valve → pressure gauge
targets.description: Flower-shop valve → Liberty Lanes wall panel → hold interact → collect pressure gauge.

targets.title: Groundskeeper’s toolshed & handbrake
targets.description: Kill Cemetery Groundskeeper → take key → unlock yard toolshed → collect handbrake.

targets.title: Radio House wire search
targets.description: Mangler blast opens Radio House → search floor piles → collect electrical wires.

targets.title: Jet Gun workbench
targets.description: All three parts → upstairs Motor Lodge workbench → build Jet Gun.

targets.title: Three LTG parts
targets.description: Vacuum LTG parts: Comics ceiling / Buzz’s Cuts upper window / church balcony.

targets.title: Aether storms & S.D.G. canister
targets.description: Carry S.D.G. canister to the Pump & Pay trap; drop beside one ground emitter.

targets.title: LTG defense locations
targets.description: Defend Riverside portal → weaken the named HVT → lure it to the canister.

targets.title: D.A.G.F. trap locations
targets.description: Kill HVT in active field beside canister → pick up charge → return to S.D.G. within 90 seconds.

targets.title: Three Strauss Counter projectors
targets.description: Read each projector with Counter; Red → Green, Green → Red, Yellow → Yellow.

targets.title: Second Aetherium canister
targets.description: Three beams meet at Pump & Pay → collect second canister → retrieve Riverside LTG.

targets.title: Second capture · storm & trap sites
targets.description: Hill Street canister → Cemetery LTG defense → weaken, lure and capture the second HVT.

targets.title: Return both canisters to the S.D.G.
targets.description: Return charged canister before timeout; resupply before the church finale.

targets.title: Church finale starting machine
targets.description: Restock armor, ammo and equipment → all players accept the S.D.G. encounter.

targets.title: All nine Aetherella figures
targets.description: Jet Gun suction → all nine figures → temporary Aetherella transformation.

targets.title: Three bank vault code notes
targets.description: Vault order: bank desk → Comics counter → bowling snack counter.

targets.title: Bank vault
targets.description: Bring colored Loot Keys from special enemies; open deposit boxes during the timed visit.

targets.title: Five bowling shoes · first game
targets.description: Shoot five pairs: gas station / hardware store / Hill Street house / Cemetery tree / funeral home.

targets.title: Bowling game & replay shoe
targets.description: Charge bowling throws through groups; collect the trophy after the timer.

targets.title: Cemetery Deadshot cans
targets.description: Cemetery fence: shoot all five cans quickly without missing → free Deadshot.

targets.title: Falling zombies trigger
targets.description: Round 10+: explode the church-front head → collect falling-zombie loot and Rare Aether Tool.

targets.title: Vending machine
targets.description: Vending-machine opening: one crouched melee per round. Pool balls: shoot for Essence.

targets.title: Black-and-gold car candidates
targets.description: Find Peeks inside an intact car → Mangler blast → trunk weapon; recheck after five rounds.

targets.title: Music headphones
targets.description: Song headphones: motel alley / church pew / Washington Avenue bench.

targets.title: Dancing zombie viewfinders
targets.description: Use both Riverside viewfinders to watch the distant dancing zombie → bus rave.

targets.title: Blood pool
targets.description: After Vermin rounds: three Semtex into fenced blood pool. Third activation adds Fire Sale.

targets.title: Church candle racks
targets.description: Napalm Burst both candle groups beside Pack-a-Punch → temporary church fire trap.

targets.title: Hidden power-up models
targets.description: Shoot the miniature; collect the power-up near your position.

targets.title: Hidden Fire Sale
targets.description: All seven hidden models → bin left of PhD Flopper → hidden Fire Sale.

targets.title: Perks & upgrade services
targets.description: Riverside for LTG parts; Liberty Lanes for valve; bank roof for LTG workbench and travel.

filters.label: Open the town & prepare your route
Build the Thrustodyne M23 / Jet Gun
First capture — Riverside to Pump & Pay
Second capture — Cemetery to Hill Street
Savings & Loan vault — three notes in order
Mister Peeks bowling — shoes & repeat games
Free Deadshot, Aether Tool & quick loot
Hidden free power-ups — save them for useful moments
